translated_title: Renovation of Mexico City's Metro Line 3 to Begin in 2027; 45 Equipped Trains to Be Purchased
original_title: Renovación de la Línea 3 del Metro iniciará en 2027; se comprarán 45 trenes equipados
author: Elba Mónica Bravo
meta_description: The 40-billion-peso co-investment replaces 40-year-old trains and rebuilds worn tracks; Brugada said no stations will close and fares won't rise this year.
